meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 在已配置 BGPT MCP 服务的前提下,装上这个技能后,Claude 能搜索科学论文,并返回从全文提取的结构化数据:方法、定量结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等 25 个以上字段。
howto.when: 当用户想查找科学论文且需要摘要之外的实验细节(方法、样本量、效应量),或要做系统综述、证据汇总时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜“CRISPR 基因编辑在人类细胞中的效率”的论文
say.note: 会返回含方法、样本量等字段的论文结果。

say.text: 找乳腺癌治疗的研究,列出每篇的样本量和结论
say.note: 会返回含样本量、质量评分、结论等的结构化结果。

say.text: 比较不同降压药物的临床研究,按质量评分排序
say.note: 返回的每篇论文都带质量评分,便于比较。

howto.what_en: With the BGPT MCP service configured, this skill lets Claude search scientific papers and return structured data pulled from full texts—methods, quantitative results, sample sizes, quality scores, conclusions, etc. (25+ fields per paper).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to find scientific papers and needs experimental details beyond the abstract (methods, sample sizes, effect sizes), or is doing a systematic review or evidence synthesis.

say_en.text: Search for papers on CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells
say_en.note: Returns structured fields such as methods and sample size.

say_en.text: Find breast cancer treatment studies and list sample sizes and conclusions
say_en.note: Each result includes sample size, quality score, conclusion, etc.

say_en.text: Compare clinical studies of antihypertensive drugs, sorted by quality score
say_en.note: Each paper has a quality score, making comparison easy.
